t: Velocidex Query Language (VQL) :: Velociraptor - Digging deeper!
s: Velociraptor is powered by VQL and VQL is the killer feature which makes it so powerful. But what exactly is VQL? This section is a quick overview of VQL.

While VQL syntax is similar to SQL, SQL was designed to work on static tables in a database. In VQL, the data sources are not actually static tables on disk - they are provided by code that runs to generate rows.
